what_happened.line: Planning Board voted unanimously to release its March 24 executive session minutes without redaction.
The board found no error or sensitive content requiring further executive session before releasing them.
Board members agreed that any future error found in released executive-session minutes would be handled by voting to re-enter executive session, not raised publicly.
The meeting was virtual-only, drew no public attendance or comment, and lasted about seven minutes.
